description: Manifests that the JSON Schema and both SDK loaders must reject. 'error' is a substring of the loader's error message, identical in the Python and TypeScript SDKs.

cases.name: unknown key in a tool object
cases.error: ToolManifest: tools.verify_business: unknown key "purposes"

cases.name: unknown key in caps
cases.error: ToolManifest: tools.verify_business.caps: unknown key "per_week"

cases.name: unknown top-level key in a 0.6 manifest
cases.error: ToolManifest: unknown top-level key "owner"

cases.name: requires_decision on a read tool
cases.error: ToolManifest: tools.resolve_business: requires_decision is not allowed on a tool with read permission

cases.name: four_eyes_on without requires_decision
cases.error: ToolManifest: tools.case_decision.four_eyes_on: requires requires_decision: true

cases.name: tool object without permission
cases.error: ToolManifest: tools.verify_business: missing required key "permission"

cases.name: invalid permission in a tool object
cases.error: ToolManifest: invalid permission "execute" for tool "verify_business"

cases.name: invalid permission string in a 0.6 manifest
cases.error: ToolManifest: invalid permission "execute" for tool "get_case"

cases.name: tool value of the wrong type
cases.error: ToolManifest: tools.verify_business: must be a permission string or an object

cases.name: negative cap
cases.error: ToolManifest: tools.verify_business.caps.per_hour: must be an integer between 0 and 2147483647

cases.name: fractional cap
cases.error: ToolManifest: tools.verify_business.caps.per_case: must be an integer between 0 and 2147483647

cases.name: boolean cap
cases.error: ToolManifest: tools.verify_business.caps.per_day: must be an integer between 0 and 2147483647

cases.name: cap above the maximum
cases.error: ToolManifest: tools.verify_business.caps.per_day: must be an integer between 0 and 2147483647

cases.name: empty caps
cases.error: ToolManifest: tools.verify_business.caps: must declare at least one of per_hour, per_day, per_case

cases.name: caps of the wrong type
cases.error: ToolManifest: tools.verify_business.caps: must be an object

cases.name: empty allowed_purposes
cases.error: ToolManifest: tools.verify_business.allowed_purposes: must be a non-empty array of unique purpose patterns

cases.name: duplicate allowed_purposes
cases.error: ToolManifest: tools.verify_business.allowed_purposes: must be a non-empty array of unique purpose patterns

cases.name: uppercase purpose pattern
cases.error: ToolManifest: tools.verify_business.allowed_purposes[0]: invalid purpose pattern "AML.cdd.*"

cases.name: bare wildcard purpose pattern
cases.error: ToolManifest: tools.verify_business.allowed_purposes[1]: invalid purpose pattern "*"

cases.name: infix wildcard purpose pattern
cases.error: ToolManifest: tools.verify_business.allowed_purposes[0]: invalid purpose pattern "aml.*.onboarding"

cases.name: partial-segment wildcard purpose pattern
cases.error: ToolManifest: tools.verify_business.allowed_purposes[0]: invalid purpose pattern "aml.cdd*"

cases.name: private purpose without a term
cases.error: ToolManifest: tools.verify_business.allowed_purposes[0]: invalid purpose pattern "x-acme-bank"

cases.name: cost unit with a negative value
cases.error: ToolManifest: tools.verify_business.cost_units.base: must be an integer between 0 and 2147483647

cases.name: cost unit with an invalid name
cases.error: ToolManifest: tools.verify_business.cost_units: invalid cost unit name "Web-Insights"

cases.name: empty cost_units
cases.error: ToolManifest: tools.verify_business.cost_units: must be a non-empty object

cases.name: requires_decision of the wrong type
cases.error: ToolManifest: tools.case_decision.requires_decision: must be a boolean

cases.name: empty four_eyes_on
cases.error: ToolManifest: tools.case_decision.four_eyes_on: must be a non-empty array of unique decision names

cases.name: invalid four_eyes_on entry
cases.error: ToolManifest: tools.case_decision.four_eyes_on[0]: invalid decision name "Decline!"

cases.name: invalid tool name in a 0.6 manifest
cases.error: ToolManifest: invalid tool name "screen_*"

cases.name: invalid connector name in a 0.6 manifest
cases.error: ToolManifest: invalid connector name "acme kyb"

cases.name: connector of the wrong type in a 0.6 manifest
cases.error: ToolManifest: invalid connector name

cases.name: version of the wrong type in a 0.6 manifest
cases.error: ToolManifest: version: must be a non-empty string of at most 64 characters

cases.name: description of the wrong type in a 0.6 manifest
cases.error: ToolManifest: description: must be a string

cases.name: missing tools
cases.error: missing "connector" or "tools"

cases.name: tools of the wrong type
cases.error: ToolManifest: tools: must be an object mapping tool names to declarations
